basics.name: Han YANG
basics.label: B.Sc. Animal Science (Minor in Applied Mathematics) | Aspiring Researcher in Computational Religion & Digital Humanities
basics.summary: An interdisciplinary researcher bridging animal science, applied mathematics, and computational methods. Admitted to the M.A. in Religious Studies (MARS) programme at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, with entry deferred to 2027. Passionate about applying computational approaches — NLP, complex systems, and mathematical modeling — to the study of classical Chinese philosophy and traditional knowledge systems.

publications.name: Research on Multi-Object Localization of Rocket Debris
publications.publisher: Frontier and Progress of Computational Mathematics and Modeling
publications.summary: 2024, vol. 7, pp. 01-24. ISSN: 2313-4194. Developed a rocket debris recovery strategy using sonic booms by optimizing WGS84-based tri-sphere and quad-sphere intersection models. Employed MATLAB, including lsqnonlin and a novel traversal algorithm, to implement a weighted least squares correction model validated by Monte Carlo simulations.

projects.name: ESI-Curvature Modeling of Egg Trajectories: Morphological Effects (Independent Research)
projects.summary: Built a standardized image acquisition platform with a 2.87-degree inclined flexible-contact surface; collected static contours of 90 eggs and 270 rolling videos. Extracted 11 static morphological features (ESI, asymmetry index, Hu moments) and 3 dynamic indicators via machine vision, with vision-based ESI reaching 0.788% mean error vs. manual measurement. Fused dynamic indicators into a fragility index (RSI 0-100) via PCA and K-means, trained SVM/RF/GBDT/LR classifiers with SVM selected as optimal, and deployed the web application Egg_RSI_App (Streamlit Cloud) for rolling-risk prediction.
highlights: Provincial-level Innovation & Entrepreneurship Training Program — Excellent completion

projects.name: Machine Vision for Coupled Egg Dynamics & Intelligent Sorting (Leader)
projects.summary: Led and supervised a four-member team in machine-vision-based egg analysis and sorting theses: developed kinematic time-series extraction (centroid, attitude, velocity, acceleration), coupled static morphology with dynamic rolling for risk prediction via a PCA-based rolling stability index, trained four ML classifiers with SVM optimal (74.07% on 90 eggs, 270 videos), clustered trajectories into three stability classes via GMM, and built multi-species egg classifiers from fused HSV and LBP features (8 species, 713 images; KNN 99.30%).
highlights: Graduation thesis project of a four-member group, completed successfully

projects.name: Research on Multi-Object Localization of Rocket Debris (Independent Research)
projects.summary: Developed a rocket debris localization and landing-point prediction strategy based on sonic-boom signals: WGS84-to-ECEF conversion, an improved tri-sphere and quad-sphere intersection model solved by nonlinear least squares (MATLAB lsqnonlin), a traversal algorithm over 256 time combinations with feasibility filtering, and weighted least squares with Monte Carlo simulation to analyze localization stability under 0.5 s timing errors.
highlights: Published in Frontier and Progress of Computational Mathematics and Modeling (2024, vol. 7)

projects.name: Various Mathematical Modeling Competitions (Leader; Independent Research)
projects.summary: Led teams or worked independently on competition papers: the 2024 Certified Cup Challenge (finite-element skull model based on the Ogden constitutive model), the 2024 CUMCM (helical coiling dragon simulation via polar-angle iteration and Simpson's rule), and the 2025 CUMCM (multi-objective UAV smoke-screen jamming simulation optimized by particle swarm with dual-plane projection occlusion modeling).
highlights: First-class awards at both national and provincial levels
